problem: Concurrent stale workers can create multiple active recovery claims for the same opportunity because overlap detection is check-then-write rather than an atomic per-opportunity acquisition.
acceptance: A per-opportunity recovery acquisition has one atomic winner under concurrent contenders.
Losers observe collision and do not create overlapping write-capable recovery runs.
Append-only attempt lineage and late-return reconciliation are preserved.
A 10+ contender race test proves exactly one write-capable recovery claim and zero silent overwrites.
Current, Human Accepted, and Served authority remain unchanged.
title: Atomic recovery claim acquisition
mission: Replace check-then-write recovery takeover with a repository-host atomic per-opportunity acquisition primitive. A contender must create-if-absent a write-capable recovery lease/pin before starting a recovery run; losers record collision evidence and re-enter allocation. Preserve append-only recovery attempt history and late-return reconciliation without granting global promotion authority.

incident_repair.reason: The live Page Thread Bridge frontier accumulated multiple recovery claims within minutes for the same opportunity, despite the protocol requiring no active overlapping writer.

regression_prevention.reason: swarm-lease-lib evaluates active_overlap as an input but does not itself provide an atomic repository-host acquisition, leaving a check-then-write race between independent chats.

unblock_value.reason: Reliable stale recovery and the 50-worker stress gate require recovery attempts to avoid duplicate write-capable workers under real concurrent /wc launches.

fail_if: two concurrent contenders both obtain write-capable recovery authority for one opportunity
a losing contender still creates a write-capable recovery run
the atomic winner requires overwriting or deleting prior recovery-attempt evidence
late original returns become discardable merely because a recovery winner exists
the mechanism implies Current, Human Accepted, Served, or global promotion authority
